## Overview

This project is an AI-powered application designed to help students read and understand economics textbooks more effectively. Built using Claude Code, the app leverages AI to make dense academic content more accessible.

The primary purpose of this app is to:

- Help students navigate complex economics concepts
- Provide an interactive reading experience for textbook content
- Make studying economics more efficient and engaging
